author: DJI
description:
8 years of skies. 30 countries. One letter was written to Earth. 🌍
Snow peaks held in stillness. Glaciers crossed in their own time. The evening winds, soft and unannounced. The day giving way to night, again and again.
The DJI drones flew the rest —  written slowly, sky by sky.

Is this the world you've been imagining?

#DJI #DJIDrones #Mavic4Pro #Mavic3Pro #Mavic2 #Drone #TechForGood #earthhistory
